regime_context: China A-shares is in a one-narrative regime: Banks dominate with near-maximum score (0.958), high durability (0.87), strong breadth (0.944) and a crowded flag, but the ONLY two eligible themes (Banks, Coal) show a very narrow rotation (9% of universe) and directional=false. The trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (gate_helps=false), and the detector's own backtest verdict says absolute-trend discipline mean-reverts here, so I must be especially humble about any directional claim.
emerging_watch: If Coal's 0.887 score converges toward Banks (margin currently 0.071) while Banks' crowded flag persists AND Coal's breadth (0.2) expands above 0.5, I would retire the watch on a Banks-to-Coal confirmed handoff; until then, treat Coal as the challenged challenger, not the leader.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the confirmed prevailing narrative with the highest score, a trend-durable hurst tag, and very high breadth (0.944). The rotation detector shows one-narrative-dominant true and no confirmed handoff. But because the trend gate does not help drawdown on this market's history, this is a prevailing-flow lean, not a trend-discipline-vetted edge.
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (crowding_z 1.98, crowded true) and the trend gate did not hold on A-shares history, so mean-reversion can whip this theme and erase the lead quickly; 'one narrative' often means the attention spike is late.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS loses more than 4% relative to CSI 300 within 10 trading days.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme, but its hurst tag is 'mean-revert' with very low breadth (0.2), and its durability is materially worse than Banks (0.47). I refuse to treat the #2 momentum rank as an alpha call; this lean is only a stand-in for the very narrow eligible set and is not supported by the trend gate.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert with thin breadth is the opposite of a durable trend; the slight relative ranking over everything else is not a trustworthy edge on this backtest.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS falls more than 6% relative to CSI 300 within 10 trading days.

theses.subject: SOE Blue Chips (中特估)
theses.thesis: SOE Blue Chips score well (0.672) and have a trend tag, but they are ineligible under the trend gate and are unscorable (no proxy). The crowded flag (z 1.7) is a size-down caution, and the track record's directional accuracy of 0.337 argues against loading an unscorable, crowded, ineligible theme.
theses.dissent: A trend-healthy, high-breadth (0.75) theme could continue working if the one-narrative regime persists and Banks bleed into adjacent SOE value.

falsifier.text: An observable SOE Blue Chip proxy (none exists) is unavailable to grade this avoid call.
